name: gdn_b200_fable
author: fable
description: From-scratch GDN prefill: tensor-core recurrent path (8-token groups, mma.sync, per-column forward substitution) for short sequences; chunked WY form for long ones: prep CTAs (tcgen05 KK/QK, warp triangular inverse, mma.sync block solve, chunk transition matrices) + tcgen05 chain CTAs with the state in tensor memory; fused single-CTA path in between.
